chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, who said:

I said, 'How should the one with sexual impurity wash?' So he said: 'If nothing has hit his palm, he should immerse it in the water, then begin with his private part and cleanse it with three scoops. Then he should pour upon his head three handfuls, then pour upon his right shoulder twice and upon his left shoulder twice. So whatever the water flows upon, it suffices him.'

key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: One in a state of major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step method for performing ghusl for a person in a state of major impurity according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Zurarah, provides a detailed procedural guide for ghusl al-junub, emphasizing the purification of the private parts before the ritual washing of the body. It highlights the Shia emphasis on specific sequences and the sufficiency of water reaching the skin, reflecting the juristic principle that thoroughness (infaq) ensures validity. The narration serves as a foundational text for understanding the practical application of major ablution in daily religious life.
